summary: HCW Biologics entered a Notes Purchase Agreement with Streeterville Capital for two secured notes: a $3.2M A-1 note ($3.0M funded, $240K OID plus $30K costs) and a $7.0M B note held in a DACA-controlled subsidiary account. Closing occurred November 4, 2026; Maxim acted as placement agent for a 7.0% cash fee. The structure includes note exchange rights tied to A-note amortization, with B-note funds released pro rata. Proceeds fund clinical programs and business development. Watch dilution mechanics, DACA release conditions, and Nasdaq compliance.
